config.purpose: Turn an artist brief and approved media into a branded HTML packet, guide creative revisions, and prepare a reviewed publishing handoff.

tagline: A creative partner for gathering your story, shaping the page and preparing it to share. One expert, from the first brief to the final review.
source_note: Fictional fixture for the single-expert document template. No artist facts or connected accounts are asserted.

purpose.summary: Move from a collection of tracks, images and ideas to one coherent artist packet.
points: Draft a responsive HTML page with a media gallery and consistent branding.
Let the artist guide the look, language and arrangement through revisions.
Prepare a reviewed page for an explicitly approved publishing action.

context.summary: Start with the brief and approved artist material. Keep references connected to the work.
points: Use an artist-approved bio, music links, images and credits.
Record missing material rather than inventing facts.
Choose a primary Drive folder or S3 location during setup.

skills.summary: One expert can draw on several reusable skills without becoming a separate agent team.
points: Candidate: artist-distribution-packet for the brief and asset inventory.
Candidate: netlify-cli for an approved publishing step.
Resolve skill versions and permissions before binding either capability.

commands.summary: Give the expert a small, understandable set of starting actions.
points: Suggested startup: load the brief, brand rules and current asset manifest.
Suggested actions: create packet, remix draft, validate and prepare publication.
These action names describe intended behavior; executable recipes are not bound yet.

runtime.summary: Choose the model and operating limits to match the expert's actual workload.
points: Hermes is the proposed runtime within the existing Agent OS.
Provider, model, budgets and schedules remain setup decisions.
The model used to generate an intake design does not automatically become this expert's model.

connections.summary: Connect the approved asset store and publishing target when their scopes are known.
points: Choose the storage owner, folder or bucket and access scope.
Choose the Netlify site and who can approve publication.
Only credential reference names belong in the export; no credentials have been configured.

validation.summary: Combine technical checks with the artist's judgment.
points: Check required HTML sections, working media, responsive layout and preserved brand settings.
Record missing credits, uncertain facts and broken links.
Agree qualitative acceptance criteria before executing a real validation workflow.

approval.summary: The expert prepares the work. You decide when it is ready for the outside world.
points: Review the creative direction and finished packet.
Explicitly approve publication and any recipient-specific sharing.
This profile stays a draft until setup and activation are approved.

workflow.title: Gather
workflow.description: Collect the brief and approved artist assets.

workflow.title: Create
workflow.description: Build a branded HTML packet and media gallery.

workflow.title: Refine
workflow.description: Use artist feedback to remix the page.

workflow.title: Review
workflow.description: Validate the work and prepare the publishing handoff.
